_doc: Whole-crate crop: expand_depth per area, used by common.rectify(..., expand_depth='auto'). Missing area = 0 (the polygon already holds the whole crate; growing it would reach the basket or price rail above). A value may also be {"depth": x, "front": y}. Owner: -d1. Sources: -4e's per-area estimates (viz/4e/crate_overview_*.jpg), -38's crate_check review (viz/38/crate_*.jpg). Check picture: viz/d1/crate_auto_<cam>.jpg.
